t: You're looking at Janet Street-Porter House, a house built for the celebrity journalist Janet Street-Porter, who commissioned it. She is an English broadcaster, journalist, writer and media personality. She began her career in 1969 as a fashion writer and columnist at the Daily Mail, and in 1971 she was appointed fashion editor of the Evening Standard. In 1973 she co-presented a mid-morning radio show on LBC with Paul Callan.
